purpose: Teach: 末端/因子/ますれ/買い上げ/係数/番外/不振/とりあげ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、末端の販売店にも気を配れ
lines.en: Pay attention to the needs of our retailers down the line.
lines.style: Measured command. Clear enunciation on key terms. Authoritative but not harsh — the tone of someone used to being heard. Slight pause before continuing, giving the instruction weight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。成功要因の因子分析を進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll move forward with a factor analysis of the success drivers.
lines.style: Respectful and focused. Clipped affirmative at the top. Steady, businesslike pace. Leaning slightly forward — showing engagement with the task ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、提案ますれば、丁寧に検討する
lines.en: If we make a proposal, examine it carefully.
lines.style: Instructional, almost professorial. Deliberate pacing to let each phrase land. Not unkind, but exacting — the voice of someone who has seen careless mistakes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の買い上げ単価を分析します
lines.en: Understood. I'll analyze our customers' average purchase values.
lines.style: Earnest confirmation. Quick, efficient delivery. Note-taking energy — someone capturing a task and committing to it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 利益の係数を改善しろ
lines.style: Terse and commanding. Sharp attack on the opening word. No softening — this is directive, not negotiable. The tone of someone accustomed to results.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。番外の案件にも対応します
lines.en: Yes. I'll handle contingencies on secondary accounts as well.
lines.style: Firm agreement, slightly faster. Showing readiness and competence without over-explaining. A professional demonstrating they understand the scope.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不振店舗の支援策を打て
lines.en: Roll out support measures for our underperforming locations.
lines.style: Crisp, authoritative. Each syllable distinct. A strategic directive — not a suggestion. The voice of leadership making a decision and expecting implementation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。メディアにとりあげられる工夫を考えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll develop ideas for media visibility and public recognition.
lines.style: Concluding tone. Slightly softer than the previous lines — acknowledging the end of the brief. Confident delivery that shows the team is aligned and ready to execute.
